messages:
maria: Morning everyone — quick async standup for today. What I did: finished IAM policy audit for service accounts (TICKET-342), started a KMS key usage scan. Blockers: need approval for the KMS rotation window from infra. Today: open a PR for the least-privilege changes and follow up on the SSO/OIDC mapping docs.

sam: Thanks — saw TICKET-342, looked at the report, one nit: `kms:Decrypt` is still allowed on `analytics-sa` via a legacy role. I can remove that in my PR.

maria: @sam awesome, can you link the PR when ready? also tagging @devon for the rotation window approval.

devon: @maria yeah we can do rotation on Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC, but we need a brief runbook update. I'll take runbook edits.

priya: FYI I deployed the audit lambda fix that reduces noisy IAM alerts — saw alerts drop ~70% after the patch. :tada:

maria: great, thanks @priya. Any regression alerts to watch?

priya: nothing new in the last 2 hours. Will keep monitor on `sec-alerts-prod`.

sam: PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/452 (includes `terraform` snippet and a short test harness). Requesting review from @maria and @devon.

maria: looking now. quick question on the snippet: why are you using `google_project_iam_binding` instead of `google_project_iam_member`?

sam: good catch — using `binding` was leftover from earlier; switching to `member` to avoid clobbering. I'll update.

sec-bot: [Alert] Vulnerability scan complete for package `jwt-utils` — version 2.1.0 has moderate CVE-2025-1701. See vulnerability board {link}.

maria: adding to TICKET-353 (vuln triage). @priya can you prioritize the patch for jwt-utils in the next sprint?

priya: yep, I can take it — will open a PR after lunch.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: `infra-iam` will be deployed to staging at 1860003600. Status: queued.

devon: staging deploy ok, please monitor logs in `cloud-ops` for any auth exceptions.

maria: Blocker update: awaiting infra approval on rotation window (ack from @devon above) — will mark as approved once runbook patch is in. Also need one more reviewer on PR 452.

sam: pinging @alex from infra for a quick review :eyes:

alex: quick look done, LGTM except change to `member`. :thumbsup:

maria: sweet. next steps: @sam switch to `member` and merge after tests pass; @priya pick up jwt-utils; @devon push runbook update and confirm rotation. I'll update TICKET-342 and TICKET-353. Thanks!

priya: noted.

sam: making the tweak now, will run CI.

maria: closing note — if anyone runs into permission flakiness during staging deploy, post here and @sec-oncall will escalate. Have a good one. :slightly_smiling_face:
